reports.question: 我想用 AI 做一个像素小游戏，应该从哪里开始？

sections.readingReply:
### 跟着一个短教程，逐步动手

先看角色如何移动，再理解跳跃与平台碰撞。把教程拆成三个小练习，遇到问题时让 AI 帮你解释。

*虚构演示回复 · 示例来源*

sections.readingReply:
### 先做最小的可玩循环

从一个角色、一块平台开始。先实现左右移动，再加跳跃和落地碰撞。每完成一步，就让 AI 解释代码。

*虚构演示回复 · 示例来源*

sections.rawReply:
### Build the smallest playable loop

Start with one character and one platform. Add movement, then jumping and landing collisions. Ask AI to explain each small change.

*Fictional demo reply · Sample sources*

只做一个房间和一个目标。先写下“能移动、能跳、能落地”，让 AI 帮你逐项调试。

source.markdown:
![Pixel character and platforms: fictional tutorial artwork](https://postrove-demo.example/pixel-game.png)

## Make one character move

[00:00 · Set up the scene](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DEMO1234abc&t=0s)　 [02:14 · Move and jump](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DEMO1234abc&t=134s)　 [05:32 · Platform collisions](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DEMO1234abc&t=332s)

Begin with a tiny scene: move left and right, press space to jump, and land on a platform. Run each small change and observe what happens.

```text
Character: move left/right → press space to jump
Scene: one platform → check landing collisions
```

**Ask AI next:** “Break a character jump into three small steps and explain each one.”

*Fictional demo material and placeholder sources illustrate the reading workflow.*

chunks.translated:
![像素角色与平台：虚构教程示意图](https://postrove-demo.example/pixel-game.png)

## 先让一个角色动起来

[00:00 · 创建角色与场景](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DEMO1234abc&t=0s)　 [02:14 · 移动与跳跃](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DEMO1234abc&t=134s)　 [05:32 · 平台碰撞](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DEMO1234abc&t=332s)

从一个小场景开始：左右移动、按空格跳跃、落回平台。每完成一步，就运行一次并观察结果。

```text
角色：左右移动 → 空格跳跃
场景：一块平台 → 检查落地碰撞
```

**给 AI 的下一问：**“请把角色跳跃拆成三个小步骤，并解释每一步。”

*虚构演示材料与占位来源，用于展示阅读流程。*
